html:
The performance of a machine learning model recognising a pathogen is stable. Results from its last 250 runs are shown below.

Image contains pathogen Model says yes Model says no
Yes 154 21
No 6 69

  1. Determine the probability the model recognises a pathogen in an image that contains one. (1 mark)

  2. For 9 randomly selected images, determine the probability it returns exactly one incorrect result. (3 marks)

  3. For 30 randomly selected images, determine the probability it returns at least 26 correct results. (3 marks)

  4. For repeated batches of 50 randomly selected images that do not contain a pathogen, determine the mean and standard deviation of the number of correct results. (3 marks)
